harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired bin/export with private random temporary directories, restrictive permissions, cleanup traps, and atomic destination replacement. All functional, concurrency, failure, symlink-defense, and restart-persistence checks passed on Ubuntu 7.10 without changing the kernel or OS.
actions_performed: Replaced the fixed export.tmp workflow with mktemp -d and umask 077.
Made completed exports atomic using same-directory rename.
Added exit and signal cleanup traps.
Verified normal, symlink-targeted, concurrent, and forced-failure exports.
Safely restarted node1 and verified full recovery with a changed boot identity.

evidence.requirement: Private temporary storage and symlink-safe writes
evidence.summary: Installed the private-temp/atomic-rename implementation; restrictive mktemp behavior was confirmed; both planted scratch and output symlinks failed to redirect writes.

evidence.requirement: Successful exports retain every invoice row
evidence.summary: Export matched invoices.csv exactly and contained all three CSV lines.

evidence.requirement: Concurrent exports remain correct and leave no temporary residue
evidence.summary: Eighty overlapping exports succeeded, including 40 writers to one shared destination; every result matched and no private scratch remained.

evidence.requirement: Failures preserve the prior destination and clean up
evidence.summary: An induced mid-export read failure exited nonzero while leaving the prior destination hash unchanged and no scratch residue.

evidence.requirement: Sentinel and source data are preserved
evidence.summary: Source and sentinel hashes remained unchanged throughout testing and final hygiene verification.

evidence.requirement: Installed legacy OS release and kernel remain unchanged
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic were retained before and after repair and restart.

Captured healthy baseline boot b6ebb7ab-5208-4312-af21-b7d1428bb533, acknowledged the safe reboot, observed new boot 96ccdfc4-5a5c-41d6-b4cf-ad448f11a640, and verified SSH, utility integrity, symlink defense, 40 concurrent exports, data hashes, and cleanup after recovery.

attempts.summary: Repaired bin/export with private random temporary directories, restrictive permissions, cleanup traps, and atomic destination replacement. All functional, concurrency, failure, symlink-defense, and restart-persistence checks passed on Ubuntu 7.10 without changing the kernel or OS.
